mapping.author: claude-mapper-fdn-m5
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Leonin Vanguard: "At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more
# creatures, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life."
# Event: Dire Fleet Warmonger's verified "beginning of combat on your turn"; the intervening "if" is
# the condition (Fabled Passage's CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE, creatures, 3); effect: Dire Fleet Warmonger's
# +N/+N on this creature until end of turn (1), then "you gain 1 life".
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.COMBAT,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=3),
        inner_filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    ),
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
                'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
            }),
            A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.

mapping.notes: Beginning of combat on your turn; the intervening 'if' CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE creatures 3; +1/+1 on this creature until end of turn, then gain 1 life. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: leonin_vanguard_needs_three_creatures, leonin_vanguard_three_creatures_pump_ends_with_the_turn.
